mode.title: Query mode
mode.description: Look up a single drug (by ingredient or brand name) or roll up all drugs for a company/applicant.

query.title: Search term
query.description: Drug ingredient or brand name (mode = drug), or company/applicant name (mode = company). Case-insensitive substring match.

maxResults.title: Max drug records
maxResults.description: Cap on the number of drug records returned in drug mode.
